item.title: Admin Post - Info - Closed
item.content:encoded:
Locking this thread as another exists for the same concept in progress. Reviewers, please comment here: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13901569/requesting-greenlight-for-scp-get-keep-shelter

As per the Ideas Critique forum required reading: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas Please do not create multiple threads for the same working concept. Using one thread helps keep spam down, and prevents flooding of the forums with repeat threads. Furthermore, it helps reviewers a lot if all corresponding feedback is kept in one place so they can follow the development of the idea and its details.

If you're having trouble getting further replies on a thread, you can look at this thread for options to contact reviewers: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: Re: Requesting greenlight for SCP (Get. Keep. Shelter)
item.content:encoded:
( i cant greenlight but here's some criticism )
I really like this idea but there seems to be a lot of problems.
Why is this a SCP?
Why not just give them a amnestic and put them into civilization?
It's just normal people from another universe.
There isn't really much stuff you can put into this SCP because its not really abnormal.
You should give it a central narrative about how they took some SCPS that are not discovered yet or something. Like, put some story and actual abnormally about it.
For example, http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-1730 is done really well because it has abnormality to it.

item.title: Requesting greenlight for SCP (Get. Keep. Shelter)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): Regular page format. (SCP Class, containment procedures, description, maybe a picture)

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is an organization of about five people who call themselves the 'Get. Keep. Shelter. Organization'. (Basically a really watered-down version of the Foundation with very limited resources)

Central Narrative: (Same as Elevator Pitch) An organization of about five people who rented out a damaged apartment in Oregon and have a radio scanner to monitor nearby calls. They have been in possession of SCP-3108 at some point, but was quickly recovered by the SCP foundation.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: The G.K.S. Organization was founded in a different universe where the SCP Foundation was never established, but was rumored of. And they made it through into this universe somehow.

Additional Notes: (this might be similar to Roblox's "SCP: Devolved". But I assure you, I had no idea the devolved thing even existed until after I thought of the GKS Organization
